ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_min_abs_advantage_weighted_sum
ir.intuition: The original loss was too similar to existing ones because it summed absolute advantages from both winner and loser indiscriminately, causing redundancy. To improve novelty while preserving effectiveness, this loss uses the minimum absolute advantage between winner and loser as a weighting factor, highlighting the smaller advantage magnitude in pairs. This shift emphasizes tighter pairwise agreement, still smooths the margin with tanh, applies a hinge on the margin to penalize insufficient margin, and sums weighted losses. Weight is also optionally applied. These changes maintain pairwise assumptions and required keys, ensuring the loss differs structurally and mathematically from prior candidates.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
min_abs_adv = minimum(abs(adv_w), abs(adv_l))
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamp(margin, -10, 10))
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * min_abs_adv
if weight exists:
  loss *= weight
final_loss = sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    abs_adv_w = ops.abs(adv_w)
    abs_adv_l = ops.abs(adv_l)
    min_abs_adv = ops.minimum(abs_adv_w, abs_adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, min_abs_adv)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
